label: j input at original positions 4-7 in sequences starting with a (or t)
explanation: Sparse feature (about 0.01% of steps). It fires mainly when the input is the letter j late in the original phase (orig_idx 4-7, peaking at 5-6), in sequences whose first token is a (86% of mass) or t (10%). In-tok j holds 82% of activation mass. There is a weak tail on the <DEL> step, also in a-initial sequences (4% of mass). It never fires in the copy phase, at t<4, or on j in sequences starting with other letters. Activations are largest when the preceding input is h (precision 0.62 for that subset, top example a t 0 s h j). The predicate covers about 78% of mass, but only about 14% of the steps it predicts are active: most late j inputs in a/t-initial sequences stay silent, and no simple history variable explains which ones fire.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=a (+6.71), prev_tok=h (+3.45), orig0=t (+3.45), orig1=t (+3.06), phase=0 & in_tok=j (+2.92), recall_idx=-1 & in_tok=j (+2.92). Lower it: correct=1 (-6.42), prev3_tok=- (-2.82), orig1=h (-2.04), prev3_tok=a (-1.95).
